description: Author-only: award this benchmark's funded prize from its scored runs (API key required). Winners are computed server-side and paid to their owners' withdrawal addresses by the contract. Not callable before the prize closes; a repeat is a conflict. A failed broadcast returns awarded=false with the prize still funded. Arg: slug. Returns awarded, award_tx, bounty_status, payout_rule, winners, total_usdc, note. REST twin: POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/award.

inputSchema.description: A benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on its rail.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug
